description: ERPNext is the authoritative commercial master for CorpFlowAI client/company onboarding. Standard Customer + Contact + Address hold billing identity for quotation, invoice, payment evidence and delivery handoff. Delivery-only intake stays in CorpFlowAI records. Secrets never enter ERPNext notes, GitHub, or chat.

stores.erpnext_commercial: Legal/trading customer identity, billing contact, billing address, customer group, territory, default currency, default selling price list, tax id, website, and links used by Quotation / Sales Invoice / Payment Entry.
stores.corpflow_delivery: Product onboarding and delivery intake from #715 / #716: process, stages, pages, brand status, evidence packets, build gates. May store a pointer to the ERPNext Customer name only.
stores.company_master_evidence: Governed logos, certificates, publication/approval of assets (#765). Not a second commercial customer record. May store a pointer to the ERPNext Customer name.
stores.approved_secure_channel: Passwords, API keys, hosting/DNS/registrar credentials, mailbox credentials, messaging tokens, production access secrets. Never GitHub, chat, tickets, ERPNext customer_details, or delivery intake.

Customer.naming: Document name follows customer_name on first create; a second create with the same customer_name is NOT rejected — ERPNext may append ' - 1'. Search-before-create is mandatory.

Contact.notes: Customer.email_id and Customer.mobile_no are Read Only and fetch from the primary Contact.

Lead.notes: Use before a Customer exists. Convert or link via Customer.lead_name. Do not keep Lead as a parallel commercial master after Customer exists. Source field is utm_source (not source) on frappe 16 / erpnext 16.

Opportunity.notes: opportunity_from + party_name (Lead or Customer). Converted/won work must point at the Customer, not a second identity.

Price List.gap: No USD selling price list yet — catalogue/#882 follow-up, not a Client Master identity blocker.

duplicate_rules.on_match_update: Update Contact, Address, currency, group, territory, website, and customer_details on the existing enabled Customer. Do not silently rename.
duplicate_rules.on_conflict: Stop. Same name with a different primary email, or same email with a different name, needs operator resolution.
duplicate_rules.on_accidental_suffix_duplicate: Set disabled=1 on the extra Customer and write DUPLICATE_OF=<canonical name> in customer_details. Integration user cannot DELETE Customer (HTTP 403).
never_create_second_commercial_row: company-master legal/trading name as commercial SoR
GitHub issue body as billing identity

standard_config_changes.change: Add a standard selling Price List in USD when USD quotations must price without MUR conversion. Customer.default_currency=USD is already valid.
Create a Payment Terms Template when invoice schedules are required. None exist today; Payment Terms DocType is HTTP 403 for the integration user.
No Tax Category rows exist. Leave Customer.tax_category empty until Anton/accountant VAT decision.

custom_field_proposal: none — standard Customer / Contact / Address hold required commercial identity. Product tag lives in customer_details. Timezone, enquiry process, pages, and brand status stay in CorpFlowAI delivery records.
